0022600028.text: The Utah Jazz visit the Dallas Mavericks in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, the ninth of the season for Utah, which enters 1-7 with six straight losses and an 0-3 road record, while Dallas is 4-4 and has lost its last two. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Max Christie is day-to-day with a hip injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their last meeting came on January 17, 2026, in Dallas, where the Jazz lost 138-120.
